quarterly_data.quarter: Teradyne press release: Teradyne Launches Advanced UltraFLEXplus Instruments (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Teradyne announced the launch of three new instruments for its UltraFLEXplus platform, designed for AI and data center semiconductor testing. UltraPin5000-EM (next-generation digital instrument for pattern-intensive AI and compute devices): up to 80 times more vector memory than other market offerings (company claim), pattern loads up to 10 times faster, 5 Gbps data rates, independent clock frequencies per pin, compatible with the UltraPin2200. UltraPort-PCIe6: which Teradyne calls the industry's first high-speed I/O protocol ATE solution for PCIe Gen6 interfaces, 64 Gbps (PAM-4) across 32 lanes per instrument, with a server-class compute backend scaling to 2TB of memory; it supports mission-mode testing and high-speed I/O scan so test coverage can shift to earlier insertions, improving Known Good Die confidence and reducing waste of high-value HBM and advanced packaging assemblies. UltraVS64-HP (Teradyne's most advanced power supply): 1280 amps per instrument, 5120 amps per ganged supply, total test cell capacity exceeding 15,000 amps, and a 16V range ready for emerging integrated voltage regulator (IVR) architectures and larger, higher-power multi-die compute packages. CEO Greg Smith: 'As the AI and data center market drives unprecedented growth in semiconductor complexity, Teradyne remains committed to delivering innovative solutions' and the suite 'expands the capabilities of our UltraFLEXplus platform'. No customers named.
quarterly_data.figure: 3 new UltraFLEXplus instruments; PCIe Gen6 64 Gbps (PAM-4) x 32 lanes; 1280 amps per instrument, 5120 amps ganged, >15,000 amps per test cell
